title: asplenium umbrosum
intro: Asplenium umbrosum, commonly known as umbrella spleen fern or umbrella spleen, is a species of fern in the family Aspleniaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Asplenium umbrosum include being an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which can help in alleviating cough, cold, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and saponins, although further research is needed to confirm the exact composition and effects of these constituents on human health.
